title: White Sands human footprints (Locality 2)
summary: Fossilized human footprints uncovered at Locality 2 on the margins of ancient Lake Otero in White Sands National Park reveal human presence in North America during the Last Glacial Maximum. Initially dated between roughly 23,000 and 21,000 years ago using Ruppia occidentalis seeds, the antiquity was challenged over hard-water reservoir effects but subsequently corroborated by terrestrial conifer pollen radiocarbon dates and optically stimulated luminescence, confirming people occupied the midcontinental interior before deglaciation opened ice-free corridors.
